changelog: Completely rebuilt 0-0-2 as a self-contained landscape 2D side-view game.
Court, net, both players and ball are now real HTML/CSS game elements and remain visible even before Start Match.
Left thumb controls Back and Forward; right thumb controls Dink, Lob, Drive and Flick.
Added ball physics, CPU movement and returns, net interaction, bounce handling and score-to-11 gameplay.
Removed orientation-lock and canvas-renderer dependencies from core gameplay.
